sources.title: Mingling of the infrared and ultraviolet and the “cosmological constant” for interacting QFT in 2d

evidence.text: Solve the de Sitter-invariant Hadamard Green-function equation in the embedding invariant P, selecting the hypergeometric solution singular only on the light cone. Insert its asymptotics into a rescaled bilinear boundary expression to obtain scalar two-point kernels up to normalization.

sources.title: The dS / CFT correspondence

sources.title: The dS / CFT correspondence

evidence.text: Use the Brown-York boundary stress tensor from an Einstein action with gravitational surface term and local counterterm. After constraints and gauge fixing, express Virasoro generators as contour integrals Ln=(2πi)^−1∮dz Tzz z^{n+1}.
